# A second IP host beside the voice session (omci-session-voice.txt), for
# src/omci/drv-test.sh: IP host 2, a management one such as TR-069 uses, in
# a bridge of its own (3) with one GEM port (1700) that admits VID 300 and a
# class 171 instance that tags its untagged frames with VLAN 300. It has a
# TCP/UDP config data, but no SIP agent names it, so it is not the voice IP
# host and nothing of it may reach the host lane. Written by hand, every
# value made up.
#
# 0d00: Set 134/2, a management IP host: DHCP on
# 0d01: Create 45/3: its bridge
# 0d02: Create 268/0x11: GEM port 1700 on T-CONT 0x8000, both ways, queue 0x8004
# 0d03: Create 266/0x11: its IW TP, MAC bridged, on bridge 3
# 0d04: Create 47/0x12: bridge 3 port 1, TP type 4, IP host 2
# 0d05: Create 47/0x13: bridge 3 port 2, TP type 5, the GEM IW TP
# 0d06: Create 84/0x13: VID 300 only on the GEM side
# 0d07: Create 171/0x21: association type 3, IP host 2
# 0d08: Set 171/0x21: TPIDs 0x8100, downstream mode 0
# 0d09: Set 171/0x21: untagged frames get C-VID 300 priority 0
# 0d0a: Create 136/2: TCP 7547 on IP host 2, which no SIP agent names

0d03440a010a001100110100030000000500000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000002800000000
